SELECT DISTINCT Zip 
FROM frpm 
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode 
WHERE Charter_School_(Y_N) = 1 AND County = 'Fresno County Office of Education';

SELECT DISTINCT Zip 
FROM frpm 
JOIN schools ON frpm.School Code = schools.CDSCode 
WHERE Charter School (Y/N) = 1 AND County = 'Fresno County';

FROM frpm 
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode 
WHERE Charter_School_(Y_N) = 1 AND County = 'Fresno';

SELECT DISTINCT s.Zip
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Fresno' AND s.District = 'Fresno County Office of Education' AND s.Charter = 1;

SELECT T1.Zip
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.County = 'Fresno' AND T1.District = 'Fresno County Office of Education' AND T1.Charter = 1;
